subs.en: One GPU. Room for three models. You need to serve six.
Every request lands at the proxy.
It reads the routing map. If the model is awake, the request goes straight through.
The proxy doesn't refuse. It parks the connection and rings the control plane. Once.
The control plane keeps the memory ledger. The tin is full.
So it picks the model nobody has asked for the longest.
It moves that one out to host RAM, and wakes the one that's wanted.
The map updates. The gate lifts.
All the client saw was a slow first token.
